job_description:
• Forecasting & Optimization: Develop rolling 3-, 6-, 12-, and 24-month capacity forecasts using business demand signals, utilization trends, technology roadmaps, manufacturing requirements, and infrastructure lifecycle plans.
• Evaluate future capacity requirements and recommend growth, refresh, consolidation, and retirement strategies.
• Perform scenario modeling and digital infrastructure planning to assess the impact of demand growth, technology transitions, supply constraints, cloud adoption, resiliency requirements, business continuity events, and evolving AI workload demand.
• Partner with procurement, finance, and platform teams to translate forecasts into purchasing plans, budget requirements, and deployment schedules.
• Partner with infrastructure operations, cloud engineering, SRE, and service owners to ensure capacity supports business and operational requirements.
• Lead recurring capacity review sessions with business and technology team members to communicate risks, trade-offs, recommendations, and investment needs.
• Ensure capacity plans align with resiliency, security, compliance, and operational readiness requirements.
• Maintain accurate forecasting, allocation, refresh, and procurement records to support planning, audit, and business decision-making needs.
